source.summary: GitHub Actions ‘Embedder footprint’ runs for PR #349 (branch fix/335-handle-validation at head 64af460812efcf91a0f2443c05949294f74f32a3 — the #335 change (canonical handle operations validate handle indices against the instance handle table: resource.rep / resource.drop trap `unknown handle index N` for indices the table does not hold and the canonical wrong-type text for indices held for another resource type, canon-lower borrow arguments and canon-lift result handles are validated at the component boundary) merged with current main 21edef0f0b147af7a43dcbec002673227ff8516d (PR #351), on top of earlier merges of 90f1437b1445b8523daa2f78eecb366de415ed11 (PR #340) and 4cdb5ae4ec7cb9e64252743ffb86588bd13b3468 (PR #348), with the runtime conflicts against #342's handle transfer resolved as a union (borrow validation runs on the caller's indices before the transfer rewrites them, and HandleTable keeps both validate_handle and the entry-transfer methods), the vendored resources/handle-table.wast exclusion removed because the file passes in full with both #335 and #342 in the tree, and #342's wrong-type drop assertion updated to the canonical #335 trap text; ubuntu-24.04, Rust 1.96.0): workflow_dispatch runs 45582728131, 45582743154 and 45582760202 against the branch and pull-request run 45582733556, which built the same tree, produced byte-identical sizes for every gated series
source.derivation: Re-baseline for PR #349 (#335, canonical handle operations validate handle indices against the instance handle table). The branch merged current main three times (merge commits 2ca257e, main at 90f1437b1445b8523daa2f78eecb366de415ed11 (PR #340); 6e9d168, main at 4cdb5ae4ec7cb9e64252743ffb86588bd13b3468 (PR #348); and 64af460, main at 21edef0f0b147af7a43dcbec002673227ff8516d (PR #351)). Attribution was isolated by measuring current main alone three times (workflow_dispatch runs 45582776999, 45582793584 and 45582813360 on main at 21edef0f0b147af7a43dcbec002673227ff8516d; all three runs pass the gate against main's checked-in baseline). Against the checked-in baseline, the main control is byte-identical on 12 of the 16 measured series; on 4 series it measures uniformly slightly below that baseline (stripped file -32 B and stripped .text -32 B in release/component, -48 B / -32 B in release/wasi and release/wasi-threads, -16 B / +0 B in release-size/wasi-threads), because that baseline was snapshotted from PR #348's branch tree and the squash-merged main measures slightly smaller (the gate passes shrinkage, so the staleness was inert). This PR's own delta against the main control is confined to the 12 series of the three configurations that link telomere-component: in release, stripped file +4,272 B (component), +4,288 B (wasi) and +4,288 B (wasi-threads) and stripped .text +3,280 B in each; in release-size, stripped file +3,144 B / +3,128 B / +3,112 B and stripped .text +2,080 B in each. Every other configuration is byte-identical to main in both profiles. Against the original #164 baseline, the largest cumulative growth is now the release component stripped file series at +10.46% (2,433,656 B to 2,688,168 B), up from +10.29%.
